claims.text: GAO-04-332 found that DoD could not provide adequate assurances that its oversight ensures the protection of classified information at contractor facilities.
David Grusch testified on 26 July 2023 that material and programmes had been placed with defence contractors outside congressional oversight.
In May 2026 a group of House Republicans led by Rep. Eric Burlison sent a letter targeting private UFO contractors.

desc: Moving a programme into a prime contractor does not merely add secrecy - it changes the legal category of everything inside it. Contractor records are not agency records and so fall outside the Freedom of Information Act; contractor facilities are inspected by the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency rather than by congressional staff; and proprietary data markings restrict government-side circulation independently of classification. GAO reported in 2004 that DoD could not provide adequate assurance that its industrial security oversight was protecting classified information at contractor facilities - a finding about the mechanism's opacity from the government's own auditor. This is the structural reason the custody question and the contractor question are the same question: an object on a contractor's shelf is legally further from Congress than the same object on a government shelf, without any change in its classification. The named firms recur across sworn and named-source testimony rather than across documents, which is precisely why this domain is scored on the C axis and researched through contract data, facility clearance records and personnel movement. Scoring high here means an entity is alleged to hold material or to have managed those who do.
